finalText:
**Written to `HANDOFF.md`.** It has the full evidence trail.

The short version:

1. **Root cause.** Config generation 119 turned on connection-per-request pooling. The pool of 20 saturated 37 seconds later and never recovered.
2. **Window.** `02:14:18.972Z` to at least `03:59:27.974Z`. Still failing when the log ends.
3. **Roll back `dep-4471`.** Revert the whole generation, back to 118. It also raised the upstream timeout, which made the drain slower.

One thing I found while writing it. 212 requests logged a slow-acquire warning and then no status at all. They hung. Counting those, every real endpoint was down. The only 200s in the window were `/health`, which is why the page took 67 minutes.
